name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for dismantling and reassembling anything mechanical. This curiosity led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in automotive technology. She joined ART Grand Prix after several years honing her skills in smaller racing teams, where she developed a reputation for her meticulous approach to problem-solving and data analysis. 

At ART, Anneliese thrives on the high-pressure environment and the challenge of extracting every last ounce of performance from the car. Her ability to quickly identify and rectify issues during races has made her an invaluable asset to the team. She believes in a collaborative approach, working closely with the drivers and mechanics to ensure everyone is aligned and focused on achieving the best possible result. Anneliese's methodical nature, coupled with her relentless pursuit of perfection, sets her apart and makes her a formidable race engineer.

Driven by a fierce ambition to climb to the top, Anneliese strives to push the boundaries of engineering, eager to innovate and explore new approaches that give the team a competitive edge. Though sometimes seen as overly critical, her demanding standards are motivated by a genuine desire to win and to foster a culture of excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Anneliese has a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting every adjustment and observation.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having her coffee black, brewed precisely to her specifications, before every race.
